Build an n8n community node for VNTANA’s Admin API. MVP: Products and Authentication. Use **declarative style**—JSON-based routing, not `execute()`. Base URL: `https://api-platform.vntana.com`; auth header: `X-AUTH-TOKEN`. Auth is login → refresh-token with `organizationUuid`; store the org-specific token in credentials.

MVP endpoints: Get Product `GET /v1/products/{uuid}`; Search Products `POST /v1/products/clients/search`; Update Product `PUT /v1/products`; Delete Product `DELETE /v1/products/delete`; Update Status `PUT /v1/products/status`; List Organizations `GET /v1/organizations`; List Workspaces `GET /v1/clients/client-organizations`. Responses: `{ success: boolean, errors: [], response: {...} }`.

Use `httpRequest`; `this.helpers.request()` is not allowed.

Commands:
```
npm run build
npm run dev
npm run lint
npm run lintfix
npm link
cd ~/.n8n/custom && npm link n8n-nodes-vntana
```

**IMPORTANT:** All new operations must have unit tests. Run tests before any manual testing:
**IMPORTANT:** Before asking the user to test in n8n, verify the implementation works:
If it doesn't work with curl, it won't work with n8n. Always verify API calls work:
```
curl -X POST "https://api-platform.vntana.com/v1/<endpoint>" \
-H "Content-Type: application/json" \
-H "X-AUTH-TOKEN: Bearer <token>" \
npm run build
<REDACTED_USERPATH>/GitHub/VNTANA-n8n-node/.claude/skills/n8n-relink/scripts/relink.sh
```
Only after curl verification succeeds.

**IMPORTANT:** Always bump the version when committing changes to node code (`nodes/` or `credentials/`).
Node feature: patch/minor; bug fix: patch; breaking API: major. Test-only, docs-only, and CI/CD-only changes: no bump. For node/credential changes:
```
npm version patch   # Bug fixes, small features
npm version minor   # New operations, significant features
npm version major   # Breaking changes
git push origin main --tags
```
To defer publishing: commit changes; before next publish, bump version to cover all changes since last release.

Publishing: GitHub repo must be public. Run scanner locally first:
```
npx <REDACTED_USER>/scan-community-package n8n-nodes-vntana@latest
```
All code must use `httpRequest`; deprecated `this.helpers.request()` is not allowed.
```
npm run build
npm version patch   # or minor/major
git push origin main --tags
npx <REDACTED_USER>/scan-community-package n8n-nodes-vntana@<new-version>
```
Troubleshooting: invalid repo → make public; missing credential → verify public repo and `credentials/`; deprecated ESLint request → use `httpRequest`; stale scanner version → specify version explicitly, e.g. `<REDACTED_USER>.1.1`.

`ICredentialTestFunctions.helpers` types omit runtime `httpRequest`; assert type:
```
const helpers = this.helpers as unknown as { httpRequest: (options: object) => Promise<any> };
const response = await helpers.httpRequest({
url: 'https://api.example.com/auth',
body: { email, password },
returnFullResponse: true,  // NOT resolveWithFullResponse
```
Docs: `documentation/vntana-api-docs/CLAUDE.md`, `documentation/n8n-docs/CLAUDE.md`, `documentation/vntana-api-docs/swagger/` (237 Admin API endpoints).
